summary.headline: Lunar Disease Judgments in Virgo and Libra
summary.text: Astrological medical judgments for the Moon in Virgo and Libra, describing configurations with Saturn, Mars, Sun, Mercury, Venus, and Jupiter that signify danger, long-lasting disease, recovery, or death. The text distinguishes great and lesser motions, squares, diameters, trines, conjunctions, increasing or decreasing light, and ophthalmic suffering, and concludes that tropical and equinoctial signs generally produce malignant diseases.
